lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p30 - Listen to the conversation.

details: Listen to the conversation introduces students to the structure Let’s… and I like… and reviews the target language from the previous lesson.
Look for careful listening and following the conversation through images.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p66 - Match and say.

details: Match requires students to identify playground objects through images. Say gives students further practice of the target language and helps them progress from saying single words to sentence level.
Look for correct matching and neat lines to match the images, correct pronunciation and sentence formation.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
